title: Kissinger-Dobrynin transcript on microwave beams at Moscow embassy

plain: In the 1970s, microwave beams aimed at the US Embassy in Moscow are said to have come up in talks between Henry Kissinger and the Soviet diplomat Anatoly Dobrynin, with a man named Walter Stoessel also named. Michels tells this himself and points to a recently declassified transcript from the SALT talks, the US-Soviet negotiations on limiting nuclear arms, held during détente, the easing of Cold War tensions. If true, it would show the beaming was discussed at the very top.
